podcast.body: Matt Good's career continued successfully long after the 1990s, indicating the enduring impact of the Can Rock Revolution. "Many acts survived long after the decade ended. The tragically hip, Sloan, R80p, Serma Glockland, Tea Party, Matt Good, many others."
